# cpanel_email_routing (Resource)

Manages cPanel email routing for an existing account domain. This changes cPanel's local delivery configuration, does not edit MX DNS records, and restores the mode observed when Terraform first took ownership.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "cpanel_email_routing" "mail" {
  domain = "mail.example.com"
  mode   = "remote"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `domain` (String) The existing account domain to manage.
- `mode` (String) The cPanel email routing mode: `auto`, `local`, `backup`, or `remote`.

### Read-Only

- `detected_mode` (String) The effective routing mode detected from the highest-priority mail exchanger.
- `primary_exchanger` (String) The highest-priority mail exchanger reported by cPanel.
- `restore_mode` (String) The email routing mode that Terraform restores when the resource is removed.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import cpanel_email_routing.mail mail.example.com
```
